unit_of_count: One mathematical or categorical feature family. Transformations, missingness flags, encodings, interactions, and hyperparameter variants are not additional families.

features.name: reference_overlap_novelty_t0
features.label_zh: 既有论文参考文献集合低重叠度
features.formula: 1 - mean_j(|R_i ∩ R_j| / |R_i ∪ R_j|), where j is a strictly-prior same-field paper sharing at least one reference with focal paper i
features.direction: higher means a less previously overlapping reference configuration
features.missing_rule: Null without a valid prior bibliography or eligible strictly-prior same-field comparison paper.
features.evidence_summary: A direct, outcome-blind measure of how little the focal knowledge set overlaps prior papers; retained from the independently audited pure-novelty package.

features.name: first_time_source_pair_share
features.label_zh: 首次出现的来源组合占比
features.formula: sum_{(a,b) in P_i} 1[O_{ab,<t}=0] / |P_i| for unordered cited-source pairs P_i
features.direction: higher means more first-time cited-source pairs
features.missing_rule: Null with fewer than two mapped cited sources.
features.evidence_summary: Transparent first-incidence evidence, retained as support because external validation and construct discrimination are mixed.

features.name: low_frequency_source_pair_share
features.formula: sum_{(a,b) in P_i} 1[O_{ab,<t}<=k] / |P_i| with frozen k=1
features.direction: higher means more rare prior combinations
features.missing_rule: Null with fewer than two mapped cited sources.
features.evidence_summary: Thresholded rarity is interpretable but the threshold is project-specific and the audited column is not in the frozen capability table.

features.name: novelty_u_p10
features.label_zh: 来源组合低频尾部新颖性
features.formula: -Q0.10(log((O_ab+0.5)*N/(N_a*N_b))) over focal cited-source pairs
features.direction: higher means a rarer lower tail
features.missing_rule: Null with insufficient valid source pairs or nonpositive marginals.
features.evidence_summary: Source-backed rarity-tail family, but the local approximation failed the frozen stability gate.

features.name: historical_embedding_element_novelty
features.formula: Q_q(1-cosine(v_i,v_j)) over all historically prior documents j under a frozen time-bounded embedding model
features.direction: higher means greater semantic distance from prior documents
features.maximum_information_time: publication time with model training cutoff before publication
features.missing_rule: Null without complete title/abstract text and a versioned historical embedding model.
features.evidence_summary: Validated alternative element-novelty construct, but the local corpus lacks audited abstracts and historically frozen models.

features.name: llm_novelty_judgment
features.formula: No fixed mathematical formula across model weights, prompts, retrieval corpus, and aggregation.
features.direction: undefined until a system is frozen
features.maximum_information_time: would require every model and retrieval source to predate publication
features.missing_rule: Not computable reproducibly under the frozen inputs.
features.evidence_summary: Dynamic judgments are not deterministic feature families and cannot be independently reproduced from the current package.

features.name: future_disruption_index
features.formula: (N_i-N_j)/(N_i+N_j+N_k) from future citing papers
features.direction: higher means more future displacement of prior work
features.missing_rule: Undefined until a future citation window closes.
features.evidence_summary: A legitimate future outcome but not a publication-time feature.

features.name: hypergeom_conventionality_median_t0
features.label_zh: 知识组合常规性中位数
features.formula: Q0.50((O_ab-N_a*N_b/N)/sqrt(N_b*(N_a/N)*(1-N_a/N)*(N-N_b)/(N-1))) over focal source pairs
features.direction: higher means a more statistically conventional combination center
features.missing_rule: Null without at least two mapped sources and nondegenerate fixed-marginal variance.
features.evidence_summary: Captures the conventional core of the T0 combination profile; it is not itself direct novelty.

features.name: hypergeom_atypicality_p10_t0
features.formula: -Q0.10(z_ab) over focal source pairs using strictly-prior hypergeometric z scores
features.direction: higher means a more atypical lower tail
features.missing_rule: Null without valid source-pair z scores.
features.evidence_summary: The source-backed atypical tail failed the local frozen stability error and rank-correlation thresholds.

features.name: conventional_core_atypical_tail_flag
features.label_zh: 常规核心—异常尾部联合象限
features.formula: 1[conventionality_center above frozen threshold and atypicality_tail above frozen threshold]
features.direction: one denotes the source-theorized joint profile
features.missing_rule: Null if either component is missing.
features.evidence_summary: Would discard continuous information and depends on the locally unstable atypicality tail and arbitrary transport of thresholds.

features.name: field_variety
features.formula: number of occupied frozen reference-field categories
features.direction: higher means broader category variety
features.missing_rule: Null when no valid reference field exists.
features.evidence_summary: Source-defined variety component; retained separately because diversity components have distinct and nonlinear associations.

features.name: field_gini_balance
features.formula: 1 - Gini(p_1,...,p_V) over occupied reference-field shares
features.direction: higher means more even representation among occupied fields
features.missing_rule: Null with no valid field; a single occupied field has within-support balance one.
features.evidence_summary: Source-defined balance component, complementary to variety and disparity.

features.name: field_disparity_cosine_mean
features.formula: mean_{k<l}(1-cosine(profile_k,profile_l)) over occupied reference fields using strictly-prior field profiles
features.direction: higher means more cognitively distant fields
features.missing_rule: Null with fewer than two occupied fields or incomplete distance coverage.
features.evidence_summary: Unweighted disparity component with strong local stability.

features.name: reference_other_field_share
features.label_zh: 跨出论文主领域的参考文献占比
features.formula: mean_r 1[field(reference_r) != field(focal)]
features.direction: higher means a larger externally sourced knowledge share
features.missing_rule: Null without focal field or valid reference fields.
features.evidence_summary: A focal-relative breadth component distinct from absolute variety.

features.name: rao_stirling_integration
features.formula: sum_k sum_l p_k*p_l*d_kl
features.direction: higher means more share-weighted integration across distant fields
features.missing_rule: Null without valid fields or required distances; one field is mathematically zero.
features.evidence_summary: Valid composite but mathematically re-combines retained components and may conceal their distinct nonlinear effects.

features.name: field_pielou_evenness
features.formula: -sum_k p_k*log(p_k)/log(V)
features.direction: higher means more even field shares
features.missing_rule: Null without valid fields; undefined for V=1 unless conventionally set.
features.evidence_summary: Alternative balance transformation; excluded because the audited Gini-balance representative covers the same family.

features.name: field_simpson_balance
features.formula: 1-sum_k p_k^2
features.direction: higher means less concentration
features.missing_rule: Null without valid reference fields.
features.evidence_summary: Alternative balance transformation; redundant with the selected Gini-balance family.

features.name: interdisciplinary_binary
features.formula: 1[field_variety >= arbitrary threshold]
features.direction: one means threshold-defined interdisciplinarity
features.missing_rule: Null without reference fields.
features.evidence_summary: Dichotomizes continuous components and lacks a universal cross-field threshold.

features.name: log_reference_count
features.formula: ln(1 + number of distinct declared references)
features.direction: higher means a larger declared knowledge/search base
features.missing_rule: Unretrieved lists are null; a verified empty list is zero.
features.evidence_summary: A reproducible knowledge-search size and mechanical-combination opportunity variable.

features.name: reference_age_mean
features.formula: mean_r(publication_year - reference_year_r) over strictly-prior dated references
features.direction: higher means an older knowledge center
features.missing_rule: Null without a dated strictly-prior reference.
features.evidence_summary: Source-faithful center of the reference-age distribution, supported across scientific and technological domains.

features.name: reference_age_cv
features.label_zh: 参考知识年龄变异系数
features.formula: standard_deviation(reference_age) / mean(reference_age)
features.direction: higher means broader age variation relative to the age center
features.missing_rule: Null with fewer than two dated prior references or nonpositive mean age.
features.evidence_summary: Source-faithful scale-free dispersion of reference age; kept continuous instead of imposing a hotspot cutoff.

features.name: reference_age_median
features.formula: median_r(publication_year - reference_year_r)
features.direction: higher means an older central knowledge base
features.missing_rule: Null without a dated strictly-prior reference.
features.evidence_summary: Robust center already materialized, but redundant with the source-faithful mean used by the cross-domain breakthrough study.

features.name: reference_age_iqr
features.label_zh: 参考知识年龄四分位距
features.formula: Q0.75(reference_age)-Q0.25(reference_age)
features.direction: higher means broader absolute age dispersion
features.missing_rule: Null with insufficient dated prior references.
features.evidence_summary: Materialized robust spread but redundant with the source-faithful scale-free coefficient of variation.

features.name: log_prior_reference_popularity_median
features.label_zh: 所引知识的既有受关注程度
features.formula: median_r ln(1 + strictly-prior local citation count of reference r)
features.direction: higher means the cited knowledge was already more visible
features.missing_rule: Null without valid strictly-prior references.
features.evidence_summary: Cited-reference impact is a repeatedly observed T0 determinant and represents prior knowledge visibility rather than focal quality.

features.name: recent_reference_share
features.formula: mean_r 1[reference_age_r <= k] with a project-selected k
features.direction: higher means a more recent reference list
features.missing_rule: Null without dated references.
features.evidence_summary: Thresholded recency discards the continuous age profile and has no universal cross-field cutoff.

features.name: topic_publication_volume_prior_3y
features.formula: ln(1 + count of papers in focal frozen topic during years t-3 through t-1)
features.direction: higher means a larger recent research community
features.missing_rule: Null without a frozen topic label or complete prior count window.
features.evidence_summary: Measures prior topic scale and attention opportunity; retained in the extended block because taxonomy labels are retrospectively frozen.

features.name: topic_growth_slope_prior_5y
features.formula: OLS slope of log(1+annual topic paper count) on year using t-5,...,t-1
features.direction: higher means faster strictly-prior topic growth
features.missing_rule: Null without five complete prior annual topic counts.
features.evidence_summary: A deterministic prior momentum indicator, separated from focal-paper quality and retained as extended due to static taxonomy caveats.

features.name: topic_publication_share_prior_3y
features.formula: topic papers in t-3:t-1 / all corpus papers in t-3:t-1
features.direction: higher means a larger recent corpus share
features.missing_rule: Null without a topic label or complete prior window.
features.evidence_summary: Scale-normalized alternative to topic volume; excluded as redundant with the simpler recent-volume family.

features.name: topic_age_at_publication
features.formula: publication_year - first observed year of the retrospectively frozen topic
features.direction: higher means a longer-observed topic
features.maximum_information_time: publication year under a stable historical taxonomy
features.missing_rule: Null without a historically valid topic-birth definition.
features.evidence_summary: Retrospective topic taxonomies can back-project a topic before it was recognizable, invalidating a universal birth date.

features.name: topic_growth_acceleration_prior_5y
features.formula: quadratic coefficient from five prior annual log topic counts
features.direction: higher means accelerating prior growth
features.missing_rule: Null without five complete annual counts.
features.evidence_summary: A high-variance second-order summary over only five annual observations and redundant with the prespecified linear momentum feature.

features.name: log_author_count
features.formula: ln(1 + number of distinct focal authors)
features.direction: higher means a larger author team
features.missing_rule: Null when frozen authorship metadata are unavailable.
features.evidence_summary: Robust opportunity/capacity feature whose meaning differs by outcome; explicitly not direct innovation.

features.name: log_institution_count
features.formula: ln(1 + number of distinct affiliated institutions)
features.direction: higher means broader organizational collaboration
features.missing_rule: Null when frozen affiliation metadata are unavailable.
features.evidence_summary: Organizational reach is a plausible dissemination/capacity mechanism, but associations vary across fields.

features.name: log_country_count
features.formula: ln(1 + number of distinct affiliation countries)
features.direction: higher means broader international reach
features.missing_rule: Null when frozen country metadata are unavailable.
features.evidence_summary: International collaboration is an exposure/opportunity feature with field-specific associations.

features.name: log_team_prior_nature_output_max
features.label_zh: 团队既往 Nature 队列产出
features.formula: ln(1 + max strictly-prior Nature-cohort paper count across focal authors)
features.direction: higher means greater locally observed prior production capacity
features.missing_rule: Null when no focal author can be matched.
features.evidence_summary: Prior capacity is relevant to opportunity but the available proxy is restricted to the Nature cohort and therefore sensitivity-only.

features.name: international_collaboration_flag
features.formula: 1[number of distinct affiliation countries > 1]
features.direction: one means cross-country collaboration
features.missing_rule: Null without affiliation-country metadata.
features.evidence_summary: Transparent but discards reach information already represented by country count.

features.name: team_prior_coauthor_degree_max
features.formula: max author degree in the coauthorship graph containing only edges before publication year
features.direction: higher means wider prior social reach
features.missing_rule: Null without complete author disambiguation and pre-publication coauthorship graph.
features.evidence_summary: Strong opportunity rationale but exact historical author-network inputs are not audited locally.

features.name: team_prior_coauthor_betweenness_max
features.label_zh: 团队既有合著网络中介性
features.formula: max author betweenness in the strictly-prior coauthorship graph
features.direction: higher means stronger brokerage position
features.missing_rule: Null without a complete historical coauthorship graph.
features.evidence_summary: Associations are mixed and exact network data are unavailable.

features.name: team_prior_h_index_max
features.label_zh: 团队既往 h 指数
features.formula: max author h-index using citations accrued strictly before focal publication
features.direction: higher means greater prior citation status
features.missing_rule: Null without complete historical author citation records.
features.evidence_summary: Encodes cumulative status and Matthew effects more directly than scientific positioning; excluded by the status guardrail.

features.name: institution_prestige_rank
features.formula: external institution ranking score
features.direction: higher means greater structural prestige
features.missing_rule: Undefined for unranked institutions and ranking versions.
features.evidence_summary: Direct status hierarchy proxy prohibited by the fairness and construct guardrails.

features.name: bc_degree_per_reference_t0
features.label_zh: 既有文献耦合邻域广度
features.formula: number of strictly-prior papers sharing >=1 reference with focal / max(1, valid reference count)
features.direction: higher means broader prior bibliographic reach per reference
features.missing_rule: Null when the prior coupling view is unavailable; verified isolate is zero.
features.evidence_summary: Publication-time scientific-audience reach; interpreted only as opportunity and embeddedness.

features.name: bc_shared_reference_strength_t0
features.formula: sum over strictly-prior neighbor papers of the number of references shared with focal
features.direction: higher means stronger total similarity to prior papers
features.missing_rule: Null when prior coupling is unavailable; verified no overlap is zero.
features.evidence_summary: Measures strength of pre-existing knowledge-neighborhood attachment.

features.name: bc_component_share_t0
features.label_zh: 既有文献耦合连通分量规模
features.formula: size of focal augmented coupling component / number of eligible strictly-prior papers
features.direction: higher means attachment to a broader connected scientific audience
features.missing_rule: Null when the prior coupling graph is unavailable.
features.evidence_summary: Captures community-scale embeddedness distinct from immediate degree and edge strength.

features.name: bc_local_clustering_t0
features.label_zh: 既有文献耦合局部聚类
features.formula: closed neighbor pairs / possible neighbor pairs in the strictly-prior coupling graph
features.direction: higher means a denser local knowledge neighborhood
features.missing_rule: Null without exact prior graph computation.
features.evidence_summary: The local column is entirely null because exact graph computation was not materialized.

features.name: bc_harmonic_closeness_t0
features.label_zh: 既有文献耦合调和接近中心性
features.formula: mean_j 1/distance(i,j) in the strictly-prior coupling graph
features.direction: higher means shorter paths to prior papers
features.missing_rule: Null without exact prior graph computation.
features.evidence_summary: The local column is entirely null because exact graph computation was not materialized.

features.name: future_citation_network_centrality
features.formula: centrality after future citation edges are observed
features.direction: higher means greater future citation-network position
features.missing_rule: Undefined at publication.
features.evidence_summary: A future outcome, not a permissible T0 feature.

features.name: venue_family
features.formula: frozen local venue-family identifier with no citation-derived ranking
features.direction: non-ordinal categorical context
features.missing_rule: Missing venue becomes an explicit unknown category during fold-local encoding.
features.evidence_summary: Controls exposure and publication-format opportunity without importing current journal prestige scores.

features.name: title_word_count
features.formula: count of frozen regex word tokens in the title
features.direction: noncausal presentation correlate; no universal monotonic interpretation
features.missing_rule: Null for empty or unavailable title.
features.evidence_summary: Evidence is small, conflicting, and confounded; retained only for sensitivity analysis.

features.name: abstract_word_count
features.formula: number of word tokens in the publication abstract
features.direction: higher means a longer abstract
features.missing_rule: Null without a complete frozen abstract.
features.evidence_summary: Reported associations vary, and complete frozen abstracts are unavailable locally.

features.name: abstract_readability
features.formula: prespecified language-specific readability score on the frozen abstract
features.direction: higher or lower depending on the chosen index
features.missing_rule: Null without complete abstract and language-compatible formula.
features.evidence_summary: Mixed or practically small evidence and no audited complete abstract corpus.

features.name: current_journal_impact_factor
features.formula: current external journal citation average
features.direction: higher means greater journal citation prestige
features.missing_rule: Undefined for non-indexed venues and historical versions.
features.evidence_summary: Predictive but directly encodes prestige, is frequently temporally misaligned, and is forbidden by the protocol.

features.name: journal_quartile
features.formula: external citation-derived journal quartile
features.direction: higher rank means greater journal prestige
features.missing_rule: Undefined for unranked venues.
features.evidence_summary: A coarsened journal-prestige proxy prohibited for the same status and temporal reasons as impact factor.

features.name: publication_year
features.formula: calendar publication year
features.direction: context only
features.missing_rule: Missing year excludes the paper before modeling.
features.evidence_summary: Mandatory exposure-era context; never interpreted as innovation or potential.

features.name: domain12
features.formula: frozen twelve-domain category
features.direction: non-ordinal context
features.missing_rule: Missing or out-of-scope domain is not silently reassigned.
features.evidence_summary: Mandatory broad-field citation-opportunity context.

features.name: openalex_primary_subfield
features.formula: frozen OpenAlex primary subfield label
features.direction: non-ordinal context
features.maximum_information_time: frozen snapshot metadata for publication record
features.missing_rule: Missing label becomes an explicit fold-local unknown category.
features.evidence_summary: Fine field adjustment for residual heterogeneity within broad domains.

features.name: article_type
features.formula: frozen document type
features.direction: context only
features.missing_rule: Null without a publication type.
features.evidence_summary: Conceptually relevant but all eligible local papers are articles, so the feature is invariant.

features.name: open_access_at_publication
features.formula: 1[version of record was openly accessible on publication date]
features.direction: one means immediate open access
features.missing_rule: Null without a historically versioned status and observation date.
features.evidence_summary: Randomized trials show readership gains but inconsistent citation gains; historical T0 status is not audited locally.

features.name: preprint_before_publication
features.formula: 1[matched preprint posting date <= version-of-record publication date]
features.direction: one means earlier dissemination opportunity
features.missing_rule: Null without complete cross-platform linkage and posting dates.
features.evidence_summary: Plausible visibility feature with strong selection effects and incomplete local linkage.

features.name: data_shared_at_publication
features.formula: 1[paper links to an accessible research-data deposit no later than publication]
features.direction: one means linked data availability
features.missing_rule: Null without versioned repository linkage and deposit availability date.
features.evidence_summary: Consistent observational reuse/citation evidence but no full historical T0 repository audit.

features.name: code_shared_at_publication
features.formula: 1[paper links to accessible code no later than publication]
features.direction: one means code availability
features.missing_rule: Null without versioned repository linkage and availability dates.
features.evidence_summary: Related open-research evidence exists, but a cross-domain source-faithful code-link audit is unavailable.

features.name: cross_domain_sample_size
features.formula: No single cross-domain denominator: participants, specimens, observations, simulations, and proofs are not commensurate.
features.direction: undefined across study types
features.missing_rule: Undefined outside compatible empirical designs.
features.evidence_summary: No defensible article-universal formula or audited cross-domain input.

features.name: study_design_rigor
features.formula: No universal ordering across experiments, observations, theory, methods, datasets, and simulations.
features.direction: field-specific only
features.missing_rule: Undefined without a design-specific validated rubric.
features.evidence_summary: Method quality is important but cannot be reduced to one cross-domain deterministic feature, and citation association is inconsistent.

features.name: positive_result_status
features.formula: 1[results are statistically significant or support the authors' hypothesis]
features.direction: one means a positive result
features.missing_rule: Undefined for studies without null-hypothesis testing.
features.evidence_summary: Predicts citation bias rather than desirable scientific impact and would reward selective reporting; explicitly prohibited.

features.name: problem_importance_judgment
features.formula: No deterministic cross-domain formula independent of reviewers, models, and future outcomes.
features.direction: undefined
features.missing_rule: Not reproducible under available inputs.
features.evidence_summary: A valuable construct but not a reproducible article-level feature in this corpus.

features.name: protected_author_attribute
features.formula: inferred or recorded gender, race, ethnicity, disability, or analogous protected status
features.direction: not scientifically meaningful
features.missing_rule: Inference is error-prone and ethically inappropriate.
features.evidence_summary: May expose structural inequality but is prohibited as a model feature and has no innovation construct validity.
